# Comedy event reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs from data/events/*.ron and data/rulesets/*.ron. Do not edit by hand: change the
     data and run `node tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs` (CI fails while this file is stale). -->

The level is a participant: a comedy director rolls events during a match, weighted by the
world's **Absurdity** slider and capped by the rule set. How the events feel is in the
[player manual](../player-manual.md#comedy-events); this page lists the numbers. A server's own
rule set can lower the cap (0 = no events) and ban single events.

## When events happen

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Effective Absurdity | the lower of the world's Absurdity slider and the rule set's cap |
| Warning before every event | 3 s: banner, announcer line and a tell in the world |
| Rolls | every 20 s, chance 60% x Absurdity / 100 per roll |
| Quiet times | no event in the first 45 s of a match, its last 20 s, the warm-up, the countdown or the results |
| Between events | at least 30 s from one event's end to the next warning (1.5x in a calm mood); one event at a time, no repeats while others can run |
| Moods | the level is calm, bored, grumpy or giddy, changing every 60-90 s; a mood makes its events 2x as likely |
| Damage from events | never gives kill credit (the killer is "the level") |

About 1.2 events per 5-minute match at Absurdity 20, 3 at 50 and 4.5 at 100.

## The events

| Event (id) | Lasts | Mood | Weight | What happens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Big head day** (`big_head_day`) | 15 s | any | 1 | Every ship's hit sphere against shots is 3x larger. Tunnels, ramming and pickups are unchanged. |
| **Bored level** (`bored_level`) | 6 s | bored | 1 | The level gets bored and turns its "up" 90 degrees over 5 s, and stays turned: the sky, the sun and horizon assist follow. Nothing moves physically. |
| **Cat paw** (`cat_paw`) | 3 s | grumpy | 1 | A giant paw reaches in through the boundary wall nearest the busiest group of ships and sweeps 90 u in 2 s: 30 damage and a 25 u/s shove to every ship it touches, debris swept along, three claw grooves raked into the rock (never in spawn zones). Watch for its shadow during the warning. |
| **Customer survey** (`customer_survey`) | 12 s (+1.5 s) | grumpy | 1 | A survey drone parks right in front of the leader's view and asks for a rating. It has 15 hp: the star the destroying shot passes through is the leader's rating (anyone may answer). |
| **Disco inferno** (`disco_inferno`) | 20 s | giddy | 1 | The lights drop to 8%, a mirror ball descends over the players and every ship leaves a light trail in its colour. Nothing else changes. |
| **Duck parade** (`duck_parade`) | 45 s | giddy | 1 | 5 giant rubber ducks drift in a convoy along a route through the level at 5 u/s. They ignore rock, swallow shots and push ships aside (no damage). On asteroid belts they parade around the ring against the race. |
| **Everything is cake** (`everything_is_cake`) | 20 s | any | 1 | The level turns into cake: craters are 1.44x as wide, and scavenging cake debris repairs 2x its scrap in hull. |
| **Gossip wall** (`gossip_wall`) | 15 s (+1 s) | any | 1 | A face grows on the rock and gossips: every ship's position is shown to everyone, through walls and cloaks. |
| **Gravity coffee break** (`gravity_coffee_break`) | 20 s (+1 s) | any | 1 | Every gravity well takes a break (fading over 1 s): debris and ships drift free. Needs a level with wells. |
| **Hat rain** (`hat_rain`) | 25 s | giddy | 1 | 24 hats (plus 2 per player) drift down from high above and rest on rock: touch one to wear it. 3 or more hats make you visible to everyone while it rains; hats scatter when you die. The results name the Hat Baron. |
| **Level hiccups** (`level_hiccups`) | 15 s | bored | 1 | Every 3 s (give or take 1) the level hiccups: ships, debris and loose mines hop about 2 u along "up", shots in flight are nudged. |
| **Mimic pickups** (`mimic_pickups`) | 20 s (+2 s) | any | 1 | Up to 6 weapon and upgrade pickups (3 plus one per 4 players) grow teeth: they hop at the nearest ship within 30 u at 12 u/s and bite (12 damage, a shove). Each has 25 hp; a killed mimic drops what it held. Needs at least 4 pickups. |
| **Moving day** (`moving_day`) | 2 s | bored | 1 | Every pickup packs itself into a box and moves to another pickup point (they cannot be taken during the 2 s move; their timers are kept). Needs at least 4 pickups. |
| **Pizza delivery** (`pizza_delivery`) | 30 s (+1.5 s) | giddy | 1 | A delivery drone brings a pizza to a player (more likely the more damaged); hold still (under 1.5 u/s within 5 u) for 3 s in total and your hull is full again. Others can shoot the drone (30 hp) and turn the pizza into a 50-scrap pile for anyone. |
| **Rubber chickens** (`rubber_chickens`) | 12 s | giddy | 1 | Every new shot is a rubber chicken. Speed, damage and craters are unchanged; the squeak is not. |
| **Tax drone** (`tax_drone`) | 25 s (+1.5 s) | grumpy | 1 | A bureaucrat drone chases the leader at 22 u/s; each touch takes 10% of their energy (2 s apart, at most 5 touches). It has 40 hp; anyone can shoot it down, and it bursts into a scrap pile (2 scrap per energy it took, at most 20). |
| **Tired announcer** (`tired_announcer`) | 30 s | any | 1 | Every kill plays a 3 s kill-cam for everyone, narrated by a very tired announcer. |
| **Wrong genre** (`wrong_genre`) | 10 s | any | 1 | The game becomes a side-scroller: every ship is locked to a flat plane facing left or right, shots fly in the plane, and hits ignore depth. Terrain stays 3D. |

Lasts: after the warning; (+) is the wind-down (drones leave, the face sinks). Mood: the mood that
doubles the event's chance. Weight: its share of the draw among the events that can run.

## Modes and rule sets

Some modes leave events out where they would break the mode: **The Architect** runs no director
(the architect's Absurdity stroke starts events instead); **The Squeeze** has no Cat paw or Duck
parade once the walls are in phase 4; **Belt Up** has no Bored level, Wrong genre or Moving day,
and no event during start lights, a heat's first 15 s or heat results; the **Instagib** mutator
has no Tax drone or Pizza delivery (energy and hull are hidden).

| Rule set (id) | Absurdity cap | Banned events |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Belt Up** (`belt_up`) | 100 | – |
| **Duel** (`duel`) | 50 | – |
| **Heist** (`heist`) | 100 | – |
| **Hot Reactor** (`hot_reactor`) | 100 | – |
| **Instagib Brawl** (`instagib_brawl`) | 100 | – |
| **Last Color Standing** (`last_color_standing`) | 100 | – |
| **Paint the Void** (`paint_the_void`) | 100 | – |

| **The Squeeze** (`squeeze`) | 100 | – |
